driver-heading.purpose: Introduce the native driver and car choices. Mobile uses 13px, and short touch landscape uses 14px.

driver-name.purpose: Identify all nine drivers and nine car models in bold Courier New. Roster labels retain 12px text across layouts.

driver-preview-name.purpose: Identify the larger driver and car previews. Mobile uses 14px for drivers and 12px for cars. Short touch landscape uses bold 12px Courier New.

crew-heading.purpose: Introduce the full-body crew scene in pink Arcade text. Mobile uses 24px.

crew-body.purpose: Carry the introduction, horizontal-pan help, and selected driver's description.

vr-heading.purpose: Introduce setup, chapter, pause, failure, and delivery panels. Widths up to 760px use 27px.

vr-body.purpose: Carry setup and state copy beside the 3D preview.

vr-field.purpose: Identify driver, car, paint, and steering choices in native selects.

vr-loadout-caption.purpose: Identify the selected full-body character and car beneath the original artwork.

club-title.purpose: Introduce the room in two Arcade lines. Mobile uses 18px, and short landscape uses 17px.

club-heading.purpose: Identify the character, station, map, or current activity in pink Arcade text. Mobile uses 15px.

club-body.purpose: Carry native entry copy and scripted dialogue. Mobile uses 14px.

club-choice.purpose: Identify topic responses and machine actions in Courier New. Mobile uses 12px.

shadows.name: cabinet
shadows.purpose: Separate the cabinet from the page.

shadows.name: hud-text
shadows.purpose: Protect instrument text over the scene.

shadows.name: countdown-text
shadows.purpose: Keep the countdown distinct from the road.

shadows.name: race-message-text
shadows.purpose: Keep race messages legible over the scene.

motion.name: rocket-flight-sequence
motion.purpose: Cargo closure occupies 0–2s, launch 2–6s, hyper boost 6–16s, and Mars approach 16–20s. Pause freezes flight time. Race time, distance, lane, and mission progress stay fixed. Flight uses the full active frame delta, including in VR, instead of the race frame limit and substeps.

motion.name: rocket-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove rocket vibration, moving star streaks, ring travel, and exhaust pulse while retaining the twenty-second flight. A fixed union of 28 color roles preserves ring geometry across all 22 palettes. Colors continue to blend. Comfort view shortens moving flight streaks.

motion.name: rocket-theme-interval
motion.purpose: Visit every native Omarchy palette once during the flight. assets/omarchy-themes.js owns the source colors and revision. The HUD names each theme and shows its complete palette of 23 to 28 colors.

motion.name: rocket-theme-blend
motion.purpose: Blend colors during the first 40 percent of each theme interval. Resolve hull roles before the blend for continuous dark-to-light transitions. Fixed color-role slots retain ring geometry.

motion.name: rocket-star-score
motion.purpose: Give each theme a four-note chime phrase with soft synth chords, sine bass, stereo pan, reverb, and endpoint fades. Cache one stereo buffer. Follow flight time, Sound, pause, resume, focus, and MP3 precedence.

motion.name: button-feedback
motion.purpose: Provide short color feedback on buttons. Reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: driver-choice-feedback
motion.purpose: Provide border and fill feedback on driver and car choices. Reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: world-travel
motion.purpose: Multiply rendered world distance to strengthen the sense of speed.

motion.name: boost-projection
motion.purpose: Ease toward focal length 42 during boost. Normal and reduced-motion views target 55.

motion.name: speed-lines
motion.purpose: Draw peripheral streaks from 160 km/h. Intensity reaches one at 460 km/h. Reduced motion hides them.

motion.name: cameo-cooldown
motion.purpose: The first boost of each run introduces the selected driver. Each cameo starts this cooldown before later boost onsets qualify.

motion.name: cameo-chance
motion.purpose: After the introduction, each eligible boost onset uses this chance to show the selected driver. A held boost does not retrigger the cameo.

motion.name: cameo-sequence
motion.purpose: The selected driver emerges over 0.4s, turns at 0.6s, and smiles at 0.88s. The name tag appears from 0.95s to 1.8s. Return starts at 1.85s and ends at 2.6s.

motion.name: cameo-rise
motion.purpose: Ease the head out of the window. The rise value spans zero to one over 0.4s.

motion.name: cameo-return
motion.purpose: Lower the head over 0.75s. Early boost release advances to this phase.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove decorative travel, streaks, shake, bounce, tilt, flicker, scanlines, and button and driver-choice transitions. Show the selected driver's stationary smile after 0.15s and before 2.25s. Keep gameplay and exhaust active.

motion.name: pit-entry
motion.purpose: Stop the car after deliberate entry into a green shoulder bay, then show the garage conversation. The timer, lane, and distance remain fixed.

motion.name: sunrise-arrival
motion.purpose: Show the selected car at the Omarchy arcade before the completion screen. SEE RESULTS skips the arrival.

motion.name: crew-pan
motion.purpose: Center a full-body figure after a garage name-button action. Reduced motion selects instant scroll.

motion.name: vr-world-scale
motion.purpose: Scale road travel, traffic, and pickup distance in the level VR cockpit.

motion.name: vr-comfort-mask
motion.purpose: Set peripheral mask strength during play when comfort view is enabled. Other states use zero strength.

motion.name: vr-cameo-pose
motion.purpose: Reuse the original back, profile, and smile sequence for the voxel driver. Reduced motion selects the smile pose.

motion.name: vr-simulation-substep
motion.purpose: Limit each engine update within an elapsed VR frame. The adapter includes the final smaller step.

motion.name: vr-frame-limit
motion.purpose: Cap elapsed time per rendered frame before the simulation adapter processes its substeps.

motion.name: club-walk-speed
motion.purpose: Move along horizontal head direction with normalized diagonal input and room collisions.

motion.name: club-snap-turn
motion.purpose: Rotate around the tracked head position once per stick deflection. A neutral stick permits another turn.

motion.name: club-snap-fade
motion.purpose: Apply a short indigo fade after a snap turn.

motion.name: club-teleport-fade
motion.purpose: Apply a short indigo fade after a valid floor or map teleport.

motion.name: club-crew-walk-speed
motion.purpose: Short walks target points 0.45–0.85m from each home position. Candidate paths use 0.08m checks and a 0.36m crew radius. Live footprints reserve map destinations, machine approach points, player space, and conversation-panel space. Characters stop within 3.2m of the player or during their own conversation.

motion.name: club-crew-pose-blend
motion.purpose: Blend the nine distinct gestures with the walk pose. The selected conversation character fades its gesture. Pause freezes the crew clock, gait, and position.

motion.name: club-coffee-sequence
motion.purpose: Arm inverse kinematics raises the mug from phase 1.2s to 2.3s, holds it through 5.2s, and lowers it through 6.4s. Smoothstep controls the phase amount. The full sip tilts the mug by 0.5 radians.

motion.name: club-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stop autonomous crew walks, gestures, head tilt, body bounce, and button transitions. Keep player-controlled movement, character orientation toward the player, and machine demos.

components.name: Car radio
components.description: The stereo pairs a dark track readout with native transport controls. TUNE exposes the track selector and volume slider. Green marks active playback. Saved preferences retain the track and volume. The radio and local MP3 use exclusive playback. A matching physical stereo accepts controller rays in VR.
components.html:
OMARCHY RADIO

Hyprland After Dark

Ryan R. Hughes · 19/33 · PLAYING
components.css: .ds-radio { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:12px 20px; background:var(--panel, #24283b); color:var(--text, #c0caf5); font:12px/1.5 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-radio-display { padding:8px 12px; background:var(--bg, #16161e); border:1px solid var(--line, #343b58); } .ds-radio-display a { color:var(--green, #9ece6a); text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-radio-display p { margin:4px 0; font-size:14px; line-height:1.4; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-radio-display span { color:var(--muted, #9aa5ce); } .ds-radio button { display:grid; place-items:center; min-width:44px; height:44px; padding:8px; border:1px solid var(--green, #9ece6a); border-radius:0; background:var(--green, #9ece6a); color:var(--bg, #16161e); cursor:pointer; } .ds-radio svg { width:20px; height:20px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:3; } .ds-radio button:hover { border-color:var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-radio :focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset:3px; } @media(max-width:700px) { .ds-radio { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); gap:8px; padding:10px; } .ds-radio button { justify-self:end; } }

components.name: Native theme indicator
components.description: The theme name follows the flight phase with 12px Courier text and 12px top margin. The exact source colors fill an 8px strip with 1px gaps. The full palette changes once per native-theme interval. The example shows Tokyo Night.
components.html: 1/22 · TOKYO NIGHT
components.css: .ds-theme-indicator { max-width:240px; padding:10px; background:#16161ee6; color:var(--text, #c0caf5); font:12px/1.5 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-theme-indicator > span { display:block; margin-top:12px; } .ds-theme-palette { display:flex; height:8px; margin-top:6px; gap:1px; } .ds-theme-palette i { flex:1; min-width:0; }

components.name: Rocket telemetry
components.description: The flight HUD in index.html reuses Arcade values, Courier New labels, cyan progress, and a yellow ETA from style.css. Its progressbar reports elapsed seconds from zero to twenty. The native theme indicator follows the phase label. Mobile uses a 460px scene, 6px gaps and padding, 12px phase text, and an 18px ETA. The duplicate rocket-pad indicator hides up to 700px. The bottom strip retains ROCKET RIGHT · DRIVE INTO THE CYAN RAMP. VR reuses its dashboard for flight telemetry and MENU.
components.html:
OMARCHY ROCKETHYPER BOOST
MARS ETA13.0s
THRUST 100%
components.css: .ds-rocket-frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; container-type: inline-size; background: var(--night, #1a1b26); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-rocket-hud { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 4; pointer-events: none; } .ds-rocket-telemetry { position: absolute; top: 5%; inset-inline: 4%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; } .ds-rocket-telemetry > div { padding: 10px; background: #16161ee6; } .ds-rocket-telemetry span { display: block; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-rocket-telemetry strong { display: block; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); font: clamp(12px, 1.8cqw, 22px)/1.5 'Arcade', monospace; } .ds-rocket-eta { text-align: right; } .ds-rocket-eta strong { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); font-size: clamp(18px, 3cqw, 36px); } .ds-rocket-thrust { position: absolute; left: 4%; bottom: 6%; padding: 8px; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); background: #16161ed9; font-size: 12px; } .ds-rocket-thrust b { color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-rocket-progress { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 4px; background: var(--line, #343b58); } .ds-rocket-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(.35); } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-rocket-frame { height: 460px; aspect-ratio: auto; } .ds-rocket-telemetry { gap: 6px; } .ds-rocket-telemetry > div { padding: 6px; } .ds-rocket-telemetry strong { font-size: 12px; max-width: 150px; } .ds-rocket-eta strong { font-size: 18px; } }

components.name: Mars return panel
components.description: The bottom panel in index.html reuses the pink state heading and gold primary action. Arrival grants one 5000-point bonus per run and focuses RETURN TO TOKYO. Return retains campaign time, distance, lane, mission progress, selected driver, car, and paint, with full nitro. The mobile Mars screen uses 460px height and 16px panel padding. The VR menu uses the same return action and PATRON DISPLAYS · LOOK RIGHT.
components.html:
MARS REACHED.

20-second flight complete. Your car reaches the Omarchy outpost.
components.css: .ds-mars-panel { container-type: inline-size; padding: 20px; background: #16161ef2; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); text-align: center; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-mars-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--pink, #f7768e); font: clamp(14px, 2cqw, 24px)/1.5 'Arcade', monospace; } .ds-mars-panel p { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); } .ds-mars-return { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 49px; margin-inline: auto; padding: 0 27px; border: 1px solid var(--yellow-bright, #ffd578); border-radius: 0; background: var(--yellow, #e0af68); color: var(--night, #1a1b26); font: 12px/1.7 'Arcade', monospace; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-mars-return:hover { background: var(--yellow-bright, #ffd578); } .ds-mars-return:active { background: #c99a57; } .ds-mars-return:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-mars-return:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-mars-panel { padding: 16px; } .ds-mars-return { min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 16px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mars-return { transition: none; } }

components.name: Patron source link
components.description: The garage.css caption reuses crew-body text and names the three shutter displays. Its official source link reuses yellow text and cyan focus. Twelve local 48 × 48 palette-mapped portraits occupy cached 160 × 88 green-framed nameplates. Missing portraits retain initials, names, companies, and source text. Each PNG embeds source provenance. A separate cosmetic random source shuffles the deck. Three garage IDs and two Mars IDs are distinct. The arcade uses the first Mars ID. VR caches nearest-filtered textures without mipmaps.
components.html: OMARCHY FOUNDING PATRONS
components.css: .ds-patron-caption { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font: 14px/1.8 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-patron-source { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); font-size: 12px; line-height: 2; text-underline-offset: 4px; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-patron-source:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Start, resume, and retry use the gold pixel action.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 2h3v3h3v3h3v3H9v3H6v2H3z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>START ENGINE</button>
components.css: .ds-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 49px; padding: 0 27px; border: 1px solid var(--yellow-bright, #ffd578); border-radius: 0; background: var(--yellow, #e0af68); color: var(--night, #1a1b26); font-family: 'Arcade', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.7; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-primary svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; stroke: none; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--yellow-bright, #ffd578); } .ds-primary:active { background: #c99a57; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 16px; gap: 9px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Toolbar action
components.description: The sound control demonstrates muted, hover, pressed, and disabled toolbar states. The arcade container adds compact styles at widths up to 900px. Route text hides at widths up to 380px to fit the clubhouse link.
components.css: .ds-arcade { container-type: inline-size; } .ds-tool { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 44px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .2px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tool svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-tool:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-tool[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tool:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-tool { min-width: 40px; padding-inline: 3px; justify-content: center; } .ds-tool span { display: none; } } @container (max-width: 900px) { .ds-tool { min-width: 40px; padding-inline: 3px; justify-content: center; } .ds-tool span { display: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tool { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Secondary actions sit below the primary action in pause and results panels.
components.html: <button class="ds-text-action" type="button">BACK TO TITLE</button>

components.name: Touch action
components.description: Steer and brake share a rectangular touch surface. Active feedback represents the held pointer state.

components.description: Yellow text and an inline bolt distinguish boost from the other touch controls.

components.name: Driver choice
components.description:
Native radio labels form a 3 × 3 roster. The game adds pixel portrait canvases and a larger selected preview. Left and Right move one choice. Up and Down move three choices. Home and End select the first and last choices.

All nine drivers have back, profile, and smile cameo poses. Bjarne and Spencer use colorized artwork. Hancore uses the skull avatar. Outfoxxed follows the replacement portrait with swept brown hair, silver-framed glasses, a Tokyo Night blue shirt, and a dark jacket. Car choices reuse these states with nine distinct silhouettes.
components.css: .ds-driver-roster { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-auto-rows: max-content; align-content: start; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px; margin: 0; border: 0; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; text-align: center; } .ds-driver-option { position: relative; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; } .ds-driver-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } .ds-driver-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; height: 100%; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 4px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #343b58); border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel, #24283b); transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-driver-card strong { font: bold 12px/16px 'Courier New', monospace; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-driver-option:hover .ds-driver-card { border-color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); } .ds-driver-input:checked + .ds-driver-card { border-color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); background: #2d2c3d; } .ds-driver-input:checked + .ds-driver-card strong { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-driver-input:focus-visible + .ds-driver-card { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-driver-card { padding: 6px 4px; gap: 5px; } } @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) and (pointer: coarse) { .ds-driver-roster { gap: 6px; } .ds-driver-card { gap: 2px; padding: 4px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-driver-card { transition: none; } }

components.name: Race setup tabs
components.description: DRIVER and CAR & COLOR separate the two setup panels. Left, Right, Home, and End move tab focus. Confirmation persists the driver, car, and paint. Back restores the prior screen and confirmed choices.
components.html:
Your driver makes occasional nitro cameos.
Nine car models. Nine Tokyo Night colors.
components.css: .ds-setup { color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font: 12px/1.8 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-setup-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #343b58); } .ds-setup-tabs button { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font: 12px 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: .5px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-setup-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); border-bottom-color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-setup-tabs button:hover { color: var(--text, #c0caf5); } .ds-setup-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-setup-panel[hidden] { display: none; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-setup-tabs { margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-setup-tabs button { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 14px; } } @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) and (pointer: coarse) { .ds-setup-tabs { margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-setup-tabs button { min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 12px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-setup-tabs button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Tokyo Night paint choices

components.description:
Native panels share a state model with spatial controls. Pink headings and gold first actions introduce scripted topics, local hardware recreations, maps, and original mini-games. Normal panels use two action columns. Mini-game panels use three columns for start or restart, PAUSE, and LEAVE THE GAME.

Entry, pause, map, sketch, device, and arcade panels use overlay depth behavior. Talk panels remain depth-tested beside projected character bounds. Machine and game panels move nearer and scale for clearance.

Ordinary state transitions preserve controller edge latches. Focus or session recovery suppresses held face-button menu actions until release.

components.css: .ds-club-video { width:min(1000px, calc(100% - 32px)); max-height:calc(100dvh - 32px); padding:28px; color:var(--text, #c0caf5); background:var(--bg, #16161e); border:1px solid var(--line, #343b58); border-radius:0; overflow-y:auto; } .ds-club-video::backdrop { background:#16161eee; } .ds-club-video h2 { margin:0; color:var(--pink, #f7768e); font:24px/1.6 'Arcade', monospace; } .ds-club-video p { font:14px/1.7 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-club-video-screen { padding:12px; background:var(--panel, #24283b); border:1px solid var(--line, #343b58); } .ds-club-video-frame { width:100%; min-height:200px; aspect-ratio:16 / 9; background:var(--night, #1a1b26); } .ds-club-video-status { min-height:48px; margin:16px 0; color:var(--muted, #9aa5ce); } .ds-club-video-actions { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; } .ds-club-video-actions > * { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:46px; flex:1 1 210px; padding:12px; border:1px solid var(--line, #343b58); border-radius:0; background:var(--panel, #24283b); color:var(--cyan, #7dcfff); font:12px/1.7 'Arcade', monospace; text-align:center; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-club-video-actions [data-primary='true'] { background:var(--yellow, #e0af68); color:var(--night, #1a1b26); border-color:var(--yellow-bright, #ffd578); } .ds-club-video-actions > *:hover { background:var(--line, #343b58); border-color:var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-club-video-actions [data-primary='true']:hover { background:var(--yellow-bright, #ffd578); } .ds-club-video-actions [data-primary='true']:active { background:#c99a57; } .ds-club-video-actions > *:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset:5px; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-club-video { padding:18px; } .ds-club-video h2 { font-size:18px; } .ds-club-video-screen { padding:6px; } }

narrative.overview:
An after-hours arcade cabinet frames a Tokyo expressway in hard-edged pixel art. Tokyo Night indigo, neon signs, and a default yellow Lamborghini Countach establish the identity.

A compact instrument interface keeps the road and car prominent. The skyline, road, vehicles, driver portraits, and boost cameos use original procedural artwork. The garage and nine shareable PNG cards reuse the full-body character artwork.

The seated VR cockpit extends this world through low-poly procedural geometry. Arcade text and rectangular instruments connect its 3D road to the pixel arcade.
VR also reuses the original character, car, garage, logo, and sign artwork.

The retro clubhouse extends these materials into a furnished 1989 interior.
Beige computers, curved CRTs, wood furniture, and patterned carpet surround the original voxel crew.
keyCharacteristics: A yellow Countach is the default in the behind-the-car view.
Tokyo Night colors connect the interface and scene.
Pixel titles pair with compact monospace labels.
Rectangular controls frame a responsive canvas.
Nine drivers, nine car silhouettes, and nine official Tokyo Night paints use native radio choices.
Occasional boost cameos feature the selected driver.
Four finite chapters end with a sunrise arrival and completion screen.
Optional green shoulder bays pause the timer for four-line Omarchy conversations.
The original Omarchy text-block logo marks the start screen and roadside signs.
Cliamp roadside advertisements pair the verified wordmark with spectrum bars.
The linked crew lineup opens an Omarchy garage with full-body figures and horizontal pan.
Nine square PNG cameo cards share the original full-body artwork.
A level, head-tracked cockpit carries the same palette into stereo WebXR.
Original browser artwork connects the VR garage, cockpit occupants, roadside scenes, and final arcade.
Original voxel crew and procedural hardware share a furnished 1989 clubhouse.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the same Tokyo Night accents in the interface and the procedural scene.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Use Arcade for titles, primary actions, and main instrument values. Use Courier New for supporting labels and instructions.

dos: Do preserve the default yellow Countach and behind-the-car pixel view.
Do share the Tokyo Night palette between interface controls and procedural artwork.
Do keep the full road width and visible touch controls through responsive and fullscreen states.
Do preserve focus outlines, text-backed status, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do preserve the supplied Omarchy text-block logo on the start screen and roadside signs.
Do keep pit stops optional through deliberate entry into a marked shoulder bay.
Do preserve the wide garage scene and figure size through horizontal pan on mobile.
Do keep source provenance in exported PNG artwork.
donts: Don't smooth the pixel artwork or replace its hard-edged geometry with photographic imagery.
Don't replace rectangular arcade controls with pill-shaped controls.
Don't let skyline detail obscure checkpoint information.
Don't repeat the cameo continuously during one held boost.
Don't add Cliamp advertisements to garage scenes.
